problem: Repository accumulated thousands of historical branches and superseded generated PR candidates, obscuring canonical active lineage.
root_cause: Generated writer candidates and branches had creation semantics but no deterministic supersession and terminal cleanup contract.
prevention: Keep at most one newest generated candidate per writer family.
Auto-close only bot-created superseded candidates whose complete delta is explicitly discardable.
Delete orphan writer branches only when GitHub compare proves ahead_by=0.
Never delete branches with unique commits; retain and report them for reconciliation.
Emit machine-readable cleanup evidence on every audit/apply run.
